title: Graph-Spectral Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
method_summary: 通过图 Dirichlet 能量与动能构造固定端点输运路径，在图频率上求解插值；以正常训练分布的速度失配构造异常分数。
reproduction_gap: 代码、主消融或组件已按原文还原；仍缺：author-verified graph estimator/projection convention；exact mTSBench split/window-to-point aggregation；validation schedule/early stopping；MLP/CNN velocity architecture comparison；all sensitivity experiments and 10-seed datasets

anchors.review: curated synopsis; marker verified in extracted text; not a full-page manual review

design_choices: Paper does not identify the estimator producing its edge-weight matrix; abs-Pearson from training windows is an explicit local fallback. Prefer caller-supplied verified adjacency.
MLP projection axes/normalization dimensions are explicit local choices consistent with described alternating temporal/channel mixer, not certified author architecture.
Interior time grid j/(T+1), j=1..T; source samples shared across windows for chunk-independent deterministic scoring.
No early-stopping/validation scheduler or exact mTSBench preprocessing has yet been implemented; 1500 epochs is the paper maximum, not a validated local optimum.
configuration.evaluation: frozen grouped train/validation/test protocol required; no test-label threshold tuning; no synthetic benchmark claim
